purpose: requested capability -> capability resolver -> effective capability -> degradation/rejection. Machine-readable; no silent downgrade; no silent drop.

rejection.rule: a boolean requirement set true MUST have its mapped host capability SUPPORTED, otherwise the sandbox is REJECTED BEFORE CREATE with this code; no fallback rewriting (no USER->0, no RLIMIT sold as hard limit, no unfiltered seccomp)

policy_rejection.rule: SingleIdCompatibilityPolicy=STRICT refuses unfaithful UID/GID expressions (image user != 0, required ownership) at create/preflight

degradation_rule: every difference between requested and effective MUST be listed in effective_degradations; every declared dimension MUST appear in effective capabilities even when UNSUPPORTED (unsupported cannot silently disappear)

single_id_compat.strict: unfaithful UID/GID expressions (image user != uid 0, required ownership) REJECT at create/preflight with POLICY_UNSUPPORTED
single_id_compat.flatten_root: benchmark compatibility mode: ownership/USER flattening allowed, MUST be visible in effective_degradations with capability identity.ownership_model
single_id_compat.note: policy never downgrades an explicit true requirement in requirements_map; it governs ownership/USER faithfulness only

image_user_rule.applies_when: spec.image.user is set and != "0" and != "root" and host identity.uid_mapping_mode == SINGLE_ID
image_user_rule.FLATTEN_ROOT: ACCEPT with degradation identity.ownership_model=FLATTENED (image user folded to 0, disclosed)
